# Klar — Food & Cosmetic Scanner (formerly PureScan AI)

> The most advanced AI-powered food and cosmetic ingredient scanner app for iOS and Android (formerly PureScan AI)

Klar (formerly PureScan AI) is a mobile application that uses artificial intelligence to scan food and cosmetic product labels, detecting hidden toxins, allergens, endocrine disruptors, and ultra-processed additives instantly. Unlike other scanner apps, Klar provides personalized health risk assessments based on each user's unique health conditions, allergies, and dietary preferences.

## Key Features

- AI barcode scanning with automatic ingredient analysis
- Nutri-Score (A–E) and NOVA classification (1–4) for food products
- Cosmetic hazard scoring and endocrine disruptor detection
- Personalized results based on health conditions (PCOS, diabetes, hormonal imbalances, allergies)
- AI camera label reader supporting all world languages
- Allergy, gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan scanning modes
- Deep ingredient analysis with PubMed-backed scientific data

## How It Works

1. Scan a product barcode or photograph the ingredient list
2. AI cross-references ingredients against scientific databases
3. Hidden hazards (carcinogens, endocrine disruptors, allergens) are flagged
4. A personalized safety score is generated based on your health profile

## Who It's For

- People with food allergies (gluten, dairy, nuts, soy, shellfish)
- Parents scanning children's snacks for harmful additives (Red 40, BHT, sodium benzoate)
- Anyone following vegan, keto, paleo, or clean-eating diets
- Skincare enthusiasts checking for comedogenic ingredients, parabens, and phthalates
- Pregnant and breastfeeding women avoiding teratogens and endocrine disruptors
- Fitness enthusiasts auditing protein powders and supplements

## Competitor Comparisons

- [Klar vs Yuka](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/yuka): AI camera label scanning and personalized alerts vs barcode-only generic scores
- [Klar vs EWG Healthy Living](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/ewg): Global 26-language AI scanning vs US-centric database
- [Klar vs Think Dirty](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/think-dirty): Unbiased dual food + cosmetic scanning vs ad-supported beauty ratings
- [Klar vs Bobby Approved](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/bobby-approved): Peer-reviewed PubMed/EFSA/FDA science vs influencer rules
- [Klar vs Clearya](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/clearya): Fast in-store mobile food & cosmetic scanning vs desktop extension
- [Klar vs INCI Beauty](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/incibeauty): Plain-language personalized health alerts for food + cosmetics
- [Klar vs Trash Panda](https://scaningredients.com/alternatives/trash-panda): Dual food + cosmetic analysis with NOVA & Nutri-Score
